notes: Paper sets world-leading limits on ALP-photon coupling (c_gamma/Lambda) from a bump hunt of published PrimEx diphoton mass spectrum (Fig. S2), and separately ALP-gluon coupling c_g/Lambda from GlueX (Fig. S4). The observed photon-coupling limit spans ~0.11-0.15 GeV with best sensitivity near 115 and 160 MeV, values ~3-5e-4 GeV^-1 read approximately from Fig. S2. Full PrimEx and GlueX projections shown in Figs. 2 and 3 are separate projections. Data points are approximate readings from small plot; values are c_gamma/Lambda which corresponds to g_agamma coupling.
